name: Mexico City
about: Nov–Apr is dry season, May–Oct brings brief but heavy afternoon showers.
overview: A high-altitude megacity of world-class museums, markets, and some of the best street food on the planet.
costOverview: Cheap for a capital this size — meals, rooms, and cross-town taxis all cost a fraction of comparable cities.
